_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.brains_agree: Split — both brains call UP toward Hope, but the analyst's 0-for-18 coil record and lower confidence undermine conviction in that directional call; the judge's trust-weighted reconciliation and the coil base rate override to HOLD as the skilled, statistically grounded default.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with eth_etf_flows sustaining above 80 and DXY breaking below 98.5
